name: glm-gaokao
description: Gaokao volunteer recommendation pipeline plugin bundling five sequential skills: glm-gaokao-collect-student-info (step 1, student profile collection into student.json), glm-gaokao-fetch-volunteers (step 2, chong-wen-bao volunteer table via public APIs), glm-gaokao-recommend-majors (step 3, major direction and employment analysis), glm-gaokao-recommend-schools (step 4, school recommendation with personalized reasons) and glm-gaokao-generate-report (step 5, merged HTML report). Trigger for end-to-end gaokao volunteer planning; one install covers the complete pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Five-step gaokao volunteer pipeline in one plugin: student intake, chong-wen-bao volunteer table, major and school recommendations, offline HTML report.
interface.longDescription: GLM Gaokao Advisor bundles the five-step gaokao volunteer-filling pipeline for locally deployed Codex agents. Step 1 glm-gaokao-collect-student-info interviews the student and outputs a validated student.json (province/score/subjects preserved verbatim). Step 2 glm-gaokao-fetch-volunteers resolves batches and fetches the chong-wen-bao volunteer table through keyless public APIs. Step 3 glm-gaokao-recommend-majors derives major directions and concrete majors with employment analysis. Step 4 glm-gaokao-recommend-schools recommends 6-12 schools with personalized rationales in a chong-wen-bao layout. Step 5 glm-gaokao-generate-report merges the pipeline JSONs and renders the final HTML report offline. Skills interoperate through shared JSON artifacts in the user's output directory. Zero SDK, zero API key; only step 2 touches the network (public volunteer APIs).
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-gaokao plugin skills: <高考志愿咨询 / 获取冲稳保志愿表 / 推荐专业与院校 / 生成志愿填报报告>
